title: Odile and the Glasshouse
author: Edmund Voss
blurb: Paloma Zhou, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
